Hi Emma,

Welcome — thanks for choosing to work with Redwood. To get Saffron set up in our vendor master and ensure timely payment, we need a short packet of information. I attached our master data form to this thread; please complete the highlighted fields and return. At minimum we need:  
- Registered legal entity name (exact) and any DBAs
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT if not US)
- Remittance address for invoices (postal and email)
- AP contact name, phone, and billing email
- Preferred payment method (ACH / wire) and ACH details (bank letter or voided check)
- Proof of incorporation (PDF) and a completed W-9 (for US entities)

Also — could you confirm whether Saffron requires a PO number before you submit invoices, or if you accept invoices and we assign a PO afterwards? That affects our PO routing.

If you can return the form and the documents by end of week we can aim to issue your first PO the following week. I copied Kim (AP lead) and Ben (vendor ops) to help with setup.

Thanks,

Emma — perfect, thanks for the prompt turnaround and the docs. A couple quick follow-ups:  
1) For ACH we require either a bank letter on company letterhead or a voided check plus a signed ACH authorization. Can you confirm which you'll provide?
2) Our legal team does a quick beneficial ownership check for new vendors (standard for SOC2/compliance). Marissa from Legal is looped on this email and will request a 1-page ownership attestation if needed; usually the vendor returns a short attestation PDF.
3) For PO timing — we will onboard you and then issue a PO tied to the first scheduled purchase. That PO number will be emailed to billing@saffron.com and will be required on invoice submission for straight-through processing. If you invoice before the PO is present we'll route it manually which can add ~7–10 days to payment.

If you can send the bank letter or ACH auth today/tomorrow we can lock in a PO for the first purchase.

Thanks — Avery
